action--f078e00d-5449-42b5-a59e-82fce0ef.name: Investigate Sender
action--f078e00d-5449-42b5-a59e-82fce0ef.description: The operator investigates the sender of the suspicious email.

commands.description: Investigate the sender of the mail for signs of phishing.
commands.command:
- is it from an internal or external sender?
 - is the sender a known partner of the company?
 - did the email pass SPF-checks and DKIM-verification? 
- is the sender domain on any known spam list?
- does the sender domain show any hints of phishing attempts (e.g. domain of popular service with typo)?

action--b96f63db-255a-4070-a4c6-e554535f.name: Investigate Content
action--b96f63db-255a-4070-a4c6-e554535f.description: The operator investigates the message content of the suspicious email.

commands.description: Investigate the message content for signs of phishing.
commands.command:
- Does not content show typical signs of phishing attempts? (generic text, pressure to act, asking user to log in, ..)
- Are there any links in the message? 
- Investigate links for signs of deception (typo-squatting, url-shorteners, redirect-urls, ..)
- Investigate the link from a sandbox, verify site ownership

action--f3bd4dc0-2f4b-43cd-afac-83501d87.name: Investigate Attachments
action--f3bd4dc0-2f4b-43cd-afac-83501d87.description: If there are any attachments the operator investigates them.

commands.description: If there are any attachments investigate them for signs of phishing.
commands.command:
- Do the attachments look suspicious (e.g. file.pdf.exe, office documents with macros, compressed archives)
- If the sender, content or attachments raised any suspicion the attachments should be scanned for malware or executed in a sandbox.
Confirm this command to invoke a scan.

action--8c3acd19-598d-4bd7-8256-cd1166c7.name: Scan Attachments
action--8c3acd19-598d-4bd7-8256-cd1166c7.description: The VirusTotal analyzer is invoked on attached files to compare them to known malware signatures.

commands.description: The VirusTotal analyzer is used to scan attached files for known malware signatures.

action--e7e53854-708a-42c7-bcbc-015900ee.name: Phishing Decision
action--e7e53854-708a-42c7-bcbc-015900ee.description: The operator decides if the mail is malicious or not.

commands.description: The operator decides if the email is a phishing attempt or not.

action--68384f7e-d670-47b1-80e0-70931674.name: Document and close case
action--68384f7e-d670-47b1-80e0-70931674.description: The HiveCase cortex responder is invoked to document the results of the investigation and close the case.

commands.description: Invoke the HiveCase responder to document the results of the investiagtion.

action--e7388346-6d1b-4cdc-a707-8ef544ea.name: Remediation
action--e7388346-6d1b-4cdc-a707-8ef544ea.description: If the mail was found to a phishing attempt take necessary steps to prevent further attempts.

commands.description: Take steps to prevent further phishing attempts from the same sender.
commands.command:
- Remove the mail from the user's inbox
- If the mail was sent by a known bad domain or obviously malicious domain (e.g. typosquatting in domain name) block the sender
- If an attachment was determined to be malicious add the file signature to the block list of the scanner 
- If a linked website was determined to be used for phishing block the domain in the firewall 
Make sure to include a reference to the id of this case for any configuration changes you make in response to this alert.

action--f7985dc8-8308-4fa7-a1d9-1dc2b0ae.name: Recovery/Impact Investigation
action--f7985dc8-8308-4fa7-a1d9-1dc2b0ae.description: The operator should investigate if the email had any negative impact.

commands.description: Investigate if there has already been any negative impact as a result of the phishing email or if there are more messages that are part of the same campaign. Take necessary recovery steps based on the results of the investigation.
commands.command:
- If the mail was sent by an internal sender begin further investigation according to the information gathered in Step 1, i.e. investigate if credentials of an internal user were compromised
- If the mail was sent by a known business partner or reputable contact try to contact their abuse contact to inform them of a possible compromised account 
- If a malicious attachment or link was found
    - Determine if the user who reported the mail has already downloaded a file or clicked on a link and take appropriate actions 
    - Create a filter to search for other received emails from the same sender or with the same attachments 
- If this alert seems to be part of a larger-scale phishing campaign escalate this information as appropriate
